workstreams.name: Anspruchsgrundlagen aus dem Kaufrecht (BGB)
workstreams.goal: Identify core claims under Austrian civil law (BGB) for defective performance, fraud, and warranty (Gewährleistung) against a commercial seller

workstreams.name: Fehlende Baubewilligung & rechtliche Unzulänglichkeit
workstreams.goal: Assess claims related to unauthorized construction (Dachterrassen-Erweiterung), potential nullity or rescission under public law constraints affecting title

workstreams.name: Gefälschter Energieausweis & Täuschung (arglistige Verschweigung)
workstreams.goal: Evaluate fraud (§ 147 ABGB), misrepresentation, and liability for false statements under commercial seller obligations

synthesis_focus: Prioritize OGH Rechtssätze and commentary (e.g., Klinger, Zöllner) on warranty for defects (§§ 935 ff. ABGB), fraud (§ 147 ABGB), and public-law restrictions affecting contractual capacity or validity—especially where commercial sellers face stricter liability (§ 1447 ABGB, § 935(2) ABGB).
